facts.business: Parmeshwari Silk Mills Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of silk textiles.

auditor.name: Montek S and Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Basis of Qualified Opinion: Closing inventory based on management certified stock statement with no physical verification by auditors; balance confirmations not obtained from certain trade receivables and trade payables; no provision for interest on delayed payments to MSME. Emphasis of Matter: Same three items highlighted but opinion not modified for these.

key_risks: Inventory valuation risk due to reliance on management certification without physical verification
Trade receivables and payables confirmation risk
Non-provision of interest on delayed MSME payments
facts.related_party_note: The Company has complied with the provisions of Section 177 and 188 of the act in respect of transactions made with the related parties.
